method.principle: Every chronology sentence in the manuscript maps to (commit, file, status). Git establishes commit ordering only; it never establishes when a human viewed uncommitted results. Categories: FROZEN_PROTOCOL (in protocol commit), PROSPECTIVE_RETAINED_ACQUISITION (results committed after frozen commit under frozen rules), POST_ACQUISITION_FORMALIZATION (added later; narrows claims; not prospectively validated), HISTORICAL_AUDIT (outcomes predate rule freezing; auditable, not blinded).
method.verification: git merge-base --is-ancestor 803257f102232763fc88d28c14b668f9b62eb277 HEAD (exit 0 enforced by reproduce_all.py); statement-to-file bindings checked by audit_contradictions.check_protocol_reporting_provenance.

contents: paper/protocol/PEVL_PROSPECTIVE_PROTOCOL.md (eight-stage evidence ladder, binary gates, planned 95% paired-resampling intervals, secondary exact two-sided McNemar)
paper/data/pevl/timed_search_stress_summary.json (hash-pinned source of recovered actor counts and timing aggregates)
post-acquisition taxonomy files, release package, audits, closeout forms

statements.statement: The frozen eight-stage protocol already contained the evidence ladder, binary acquisition gates, suppression consequences, planned paired-resampling intervals, and secondary McNemar analysis.
statements.manuscript_binding: Prospective validation results paragraph 1; Stages 1-8; audit_contradictions provenance boundary frozen_* keys.

statements.statement: The retained preflight (1,000 units / 3,000 executions), timed-search stress (200 clusters / 800 executions), and factorial (2,000 units per cell) acquisitions were committed after the frozen protocol commit and executed under its binary rules.
statements.limitation: Git ordering does not prove when a human viewed every uncommitted result.

statements.statement: The generic claim classes, the completed-case descriptive-only Level-6 reporting taxonomy with empirical-reweighting relabeling, and the digest-plus-byte integrity extension were formalized after acquisition; they narrow claims and are not prospectively validated in this empirical case.
statements.commit: post-closeout working tree (no single frozen commit claimed)
statements.manuscript_binding: 'None of these later additions is attributed to that commit, and the completed case does not prospectively validate them'; digest-byte later-extension window; prohibited phrases enforced by test_protocol_reporting_provenance.py.

statements.statement: The historical repeated-control outcomes existed before the available-record audit gate was frozen for retrospective reanalysis. The rule uses only repeated control records, is independent of candidate-effect magnitude/direction/favorability, is not literally outcome blind, and is not evidence of prospective blinding. It suppressed an apparently favorable comparison (210/2,800 outcome-record; 458/2,800 available-record disagreements).
statements.commit: retained historical acquisition predates the closeout freeze of the retrospective rule
statements.manuscript_binding: 'That audit rule was frozen only for retrospective reanalysis after the historical outcomes already existed ... not evidence of prospective blinding'.

statements.statement: The frozen stress protocol promised first-divergence positions, actor localization, and timing summaries in the public package. At machine finalization: acting-side counts (99/99 opponent side) and per-profile timing aggregates are RECOVERED from the hash-pinned stress summary but redistribution remains PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL; first-divergence positions were NEVER_RECORDED in any retained artifact; raw traces remain restricted.
statements.manuscript_binding: Stress-test D03 paragraph; Limitations paragraph 3; PROTOCOL_DEVIATIONS_FINAL_DRAFT.md.

statements.statement: The five deterministic preflight contexts were a newly frozen, audit-informed target recorded in the experiment-specific protocol before the retained artifacts; the preflight used a different seed range from the factorial, making transfer a bounded assumption rather than trace-level evidence on factorial rows.

prohibited_conclusions: Do not describe the historical repeated-control gate as prospectively blinded or preregistered.
Do not attribute the generic claim-class taxonomy, descriptive-only Level-6 mapping, or byte-count extension to the frozen protocol commit.
Do not call reweighting quantiles confidence intervals or admitted inference.
Do not present recovered actor/timing aggregates as released at acquisition time, or positions as recoverable.
Do not claim human inspection of uncommitted intermediate results from Git metadata.
